title: Site topic guides – Squarespace Help Center

facts.fact: Squarespace's live chat support for the help center is available Monday to Friday, 4:00AM to 8:00PM EST.
facts.quote: 4:00AM to 8:00PM EST

facts.fact: Squarespace states that email support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
facts.quote: 7 days a week

facts.fact: Squarespace states that its live chat support is currently offered in English only.
facts.quote: We currently offer live chat support in English only.

facts.fact: Squarespace says a refund request receives a response within 2 business days.
facts.quote: Hear back in 2 business days.

facts.fact: Squarespace states its identity verification process should take about five minutes and uses Plaid software.
facts.quote: Our identity verification process should only take you about five minutes.

facts.fact: For account recovery, Squarespace requires bank statements to be PDF files that are official statements downloaded from the bank.
facts.quote: Files must be in PDF format and official statements downloaded from your bank.

facts.fact: Squarespace requires identity documents submitted for verification to be .jpg or .png files.
facts.quote: Ensure your files are .jpg or .png so we can view them

facts.fact: Squarespace states that tax exemption certificates may be attached in .pdf, .png, or .jpeg formats.
facts.quote: If you have a tax exemption certificate, attach it here. .pdf, .png, .jpeg file formats are accepted.

facts.fact: Under the .AU Domain Administration Rules for individuals, registrants must provide a copy of an Australian government-issued ID number and proof of Australian residency to keep a .AU domain active.
facts.quote: The .AU Domain Registry requires that all registrants qualify to own a .AU domain.

facts.fact: Squarespace says it submits notices of illegal content in accordance with Article 16 of the EU Digital Services Act (Regulation (EU) 2022/2065).
facts.quote: in accordance with Article 16 of the European Union’s Digital Services Act (Regulation (EU) 2022/2065) (‘DSA’).

facts.fact: The help center page was published by Squarespace on 11 November 2026.
facts.quote: Published Time: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 03:48:47 GMT

facts.fact: Squarespace Registrar Entities generally redact customers' personal contact information in public registration data lookups for gTLD domains they register.
facts.quote: generally redact customers’ personal contact information within registration data

facts.fact: Under the non-public information request process, only requests for single domains are permitted.
facts.quote: Only requests for single domains are permitted.

facts.fact: Squarespace expects other less-intrusive mechanisms to be exhausted before a non-public registration data request is submitted, which should be an extreme, last-resort measure.
facts.quote: we expect these mechanisms to be exhausted prior to any request submitted hereunder

facts.fact: Domain owners are required to keep their Whois records up-to-date, and inaccurate, outdated or intentionally false contact details can be reported to Squarespace.
facts.quote: Domain owners are required to keep their Whois records up-to-date.

facts.fact: Squarespace's response to trademark infringement notices may include removing or restricting access to allegedly infringing material.
facts.quote: Squarespace's response to notices of alleged trademark infringement may include the removal or restriction of access to allegedly infringing material.

facts.fact: Information in a trademark infringement notice may be forwarded to the user who posted the allegedly infringing content or to the site owner.
facts.quote: information provided in a notice of trademark infringement may be forwarded to the user who posted the allegedly infringing content or the site owner.

facts.fact: Where Squarespace is only the registrar and does not provide web hosting, trademark claims must be resolved directly with the site owner or web hosting provider.
facts.quote: you will need to resolve the claimed trademark infringement directly with the site owner or the web hosting service provider.

facts.fact: Phishing is a type of fraud that attempts to deceive users into sharing sensitive information such as credit card information, passwords, or account details.
facts.quote: Phishing is a type of fraud that attempts to deceive users into sharing sensitive information like credit card information, passwords, or account details.

facts.fact: Pharming attempts to redirect users to fraudulent sites through modified or hijacked DNS, instead of the site they originally tried to visit.
facts.quote: pharming attempts to redirect users to fraudulent sites through modified/hijacked DNS

facts.fact: Spam is defined as any unsolicited bulk email sent without the recipient's consent, including spamvertising and emails that violate the CAN-SPAM Act.
facts.quote: Spam encompasses any unsolicited bulk emails sent without the recipient's consent.

facts.fact: Squarespace will respond via email to data access request submitters within 30 days of acknowledging the request, absent exceptional circumstances.
facts.quote: respond via email to the contact address provided with the request within 30 days from such acknowledgment absent exceptional circumstances

facts.fact: Squarespace's legacy OAuth credentials request form will be decommissioned on September 30, 2026, replaced by a self-service process.
facts.quote: This form will be decommissioned on **September 30, 2026**.

facts.fact: Squarespace Help Center support messages are answered during business hours Monday to Friday, 5:30AM to 8PM EST.
facts.quote: Business hours are Monday - Friday, 5:30AM to 8PM EST.

facts.fact: Messages sent to Squarespace outside business hours receive a response within 12 hours.
facts.quote: Messages sent outside these hours will receive a response within 12 hours.

facts.fact: Squarespace states it cannot provide information about accounts, users, or sites to law enforcement without a subpoena, court order, or warrant.
facts.quote: we are unable to provide information about Squarespace accounts, users, or sites to law enforcement without a subpoena, court order, or warrant.

facts.fact: Squarespace Scheduling was renamed to Acuity Scheduling.
facts.quote: Squarespace Scheduling is now officially Acuity Scheduling.

facts.fact: On legacy Squarespace 5 sites, permissions cannot be edited, but Squarespace can cancel or remove the site.
facts.quote: Squarespace 5, our legacy platform, doesn't allow permissions to be edited. However, we can cancel or remove the site.

facts.fact: Squarespace's Risk-check review form applies only to payments blocked by its Risk security checks; a failed payment is a decline issued by the shopper's own card issuer or bank, which Squarespace cannot intervene on.
facts.quote: A failed payment is different. This is a decline issued by the shopper’s own card issuer or bank

facts.fact: Even if Squarespace lifts a payment block after a merchant vouches for a shopper, the payment is not guaranteed to succeed and standard dispute and chargeback rules still apply.
facts.quote: Standard dispute and chargeback rules still apply

facts.fact: Squarespace may forward information in a non-consensual intimate content report to the user who posted the content or the site owner.
facts.quote: information provided in a report may be forwarded to the user who posted the reported content or the site owner.

facts.fact: When Squarespace live chat is not available, the company says it will respond to emailed support requests within 12 hours.
facts.quote: Live chat is not available right now. Please send us an email and we'll respond within 12 hours.

facts.fact: A repeated connection request for a messaging number can be retried after a 1-minute wait.
facts.quote: A connection for that number was requested recently. Please try again in 1 minute.
